name: Honda CRF450L
intro: A street-legal version of Honda's motocross 450. High-strung and needs frequent service.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. All 2019 CRF450Ls were in recall 19V703 because the horn mount can break and the horn can fall off.
A-002.reason: The fix is free and quick.

recalls.what: Horn mount can break and the horn can detach.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the horn and mount free.
